package robotaccess

import (
	domain "GENRE_MODULE/game/cardrpg"
	sender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"context"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/client/wire"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
)

// Dispatch 只转换协议；玩家身份来自已鉴权会话，规则、时间、资源与权限仍由正式 Nest handler 决定。
func Dispatch(engine *nest.NestMgr, rules domain.Rules) gateway.TCPDispatch {
	business := sender.NewCardRpgSender(engine)
	return func(ctx context.Context, session gateway.Session, id, seq uint32, kind wire.PayloadKind, data []byte) (any, error) {
		if id != msgid.MsgPlay || kind != wire.PayloadProtobuf {
			return nil, gateway.ErrInvalidRequest
		}
		request, err := pb.UnmarshalPlayRequest(data)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		switch request.Kind {
		case "draw":
			_, err = business.Sync_CardDraw(ctx, session.Principal().PlayerID, request.Seq, int(request.Count), rules)
		case "start":
			_, err = business.MultiSync_CardStart(ctx, session.Principal().PlayerID, request.RoomID, request.Seq, int(request.Count), rules)
		case "auto":
			_, err = business.Sync_CardTurn(ctx, request.RoomID, session.Principal().PlayerID, domain.TurnCommand{Seq: request.Seq, ActorID: session.Principal().PlayerID, Kind: "auto"})
		case "claim":
			_, err = business.MultiSync_CardClaim(ctx, session.Principal().PlayerID, request.RoomID)
		default:
			err = gateway.ErrInvalidRequest
		}
		response := &pb.PlayResponse{Seq: request.Seq}
		if err != nil {
			response.Code = 1
		}
		payload, err := pb.MarshalPlayResponse(response)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &gateway.TCPResponse{MessageID: id, Sequence: seq, Payload: payload}, nil
	}
}
